exercises.question: If cos(θ) = 4/5 in a right-angled triangle, find sin(θ).
exercises.question_amharic: በአንድ የቀኝ ማዕዘን ትሪያንግል ውስጥ cos(θ) = 4/5 ቢሆን፣ sin(θ) ን ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. sin²(θ) = 1 - (4/5)² = 1 - 16/25.\n2. sin²(θ) = 9/25.\n3. Take square root: sin(θ) = 3/5.
